disposition_reason: Prints mean and SD of lead, cadmium, chromium, zinc, copper and manganese in 14 batches of three sachet tomato paste brands bought in Awka, Nigeria.

study.design: market survey of batch-to-batch variation: 14 batches of 3 sachet tomato paste brands (5, 4 and 5 batches), triplicate analyses
study.method: flame AAS (GBC Xplora) after acid digestion (nitric, sulphuric, perchloric) of 2 g paste to 50 mL, APHA 1995
study.qa: LOD and LOQ only; no certified reference material, spike recovery or blanks reported
